title: AWS Lambda .NET Core 1.0 runtime is end-of-life
summary: The AWS Lambda runtimes table lists dotnetcore1.0 under Deprecated runtimes with deprecation date 2019-06-27. AWS no longer applies security or other updates to that managed runtime.

constraints: Keep provider.runtime, Globals.Function.Runtime, per-function Runtime, and Terraform aws_lambda_function.runtime on one AWS Lambda runtime identifier that AWS still supports.
Raising the managed runtime can require .NET target framework and package updates; confirm the project targets the replacement before deploying.

steps.title: Raise the AWS Lambda runtime
steps.instructions: Change the reported Runtime (or provider.runtime / terraform runtime) from dotnetcore1.0 to a supported AWS Lambda .NET identifier (see the replacement).

steps.title: Align other runtime surfaces
steps.instructions: Update every other SAM/CloudFormation Globals or function Runtime, serverless.yml provider or function runtime, Terraform aws_lambda_function.runtime, and CI deploy config that still pins dotnetcore1.0.

verification.command: sam validate || serverless print || terraform validate
verification.purpose: Validate the updated SAM, Serverless Framework, or Terraform declaration before deploy.
